# ABGCMO

> Growth, GTM, and virality strategy for coding agents. Every number tagged by
> evidence quality (measured / reported / asserted). 60+ case studies indexed by
> mechanism. Diagnoses the binding constraint before prescribing tactics.

Install: /plugin marketplace add calebnewtonusc/ABGCMO

## Doctrine
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Five operating rules and the skill router
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Same doctrine, cross-agent conventions

## Data
- [data/evidence-tiers.md](data/evidence-tiers.md): Measured / Reported / Asserted
- [data/algorithm-weights.md](data/algorithm-weights.md): Ranking mechanics for X, LinkedIn, GitHub, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, Product Hunt, app stores
- [data/benchmarks.md](data/benchmarks.md): Conversion, retention, virality, sales, realistic outcomes
- [data/channel-economics.md](data/channel-economics.md): Channel returns and channel-product fit

## Cases
- [cases/README.md](cases/README.md): Index by mechanism
- marketplaces, developer-tools, open-source, plg-saas, consumer-social, ai-native, creator-media, commerce-brand, movements, category-creation
